verses.sanskrit:
वैशंपायन उवाच।
              ते वनेन वनं गत्वा घ्नन्तो मृगगणान्बहून्। अपक्रम्य ययूराजंस्त्वरमाणा महारथाः॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : O king, hose mighty car-warriors the heroes (the Pandavas), went from forest of forest, killing many beasts. In course of their travel and they crossed many forests (came to).
The countries of the Matsyas, Trigartas and Panchalas, then to that of the Kichakas, where they saw mane beautiful woods and lakes.
verses.bhavadeepa: षट्पञ्चाशदधिकशततमोऽध्यायः  ते इति । वनेन वनं वनाद्वनम् ॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: जटाः कृत्वात्मनः सर्वे वल्कलाजिनवाससः। सह कुन्त्या महात्मानो बिभ्रतस्तापसं वपुः॥३॥
verses.english: They all made matted locks and wore the barks of trees. Those illustrious (heroes) assumed the form of ascetics with their mother. Those car-warriors some times proceeded in haste, carrying their mother, (on their back) sometimes they proceeded slowly; they then went in great haste.

verses.sanskrit: क्वचिद्वहन्तो जननीं त्वरमाणा महारथाः। क्वचिच्छन्देन गच्छन्तस्ते जग्मुः प्रसभं पुनः॥४॥
ब्राह्मं वेदमधीयाना वेदाङ्गानि च सर्वशः। नीतिशास्त्रं च सर्वज्ञा ददृशुस्ते पितामहम्॥५॥
verses.english: They studied the Brahma (Rik) and the Vedangas and all other sciences of morals. (When they were thus engaged), they saw their grandfather (Vyasa).

verses.sanskrit: तेऽभिवाद्य महात्मानं कृष्णद्वैपायनं तदा। तस्थुः प्राञ्जलयः सर्वे सह मात्रा परन्तपाः॥६॥
verses.english: Having respectfully saluted the illustrious Krishna Dvaipayana those chastisers of foes with their mother stood before him with joined hands.
verses.bhavadeepa: ब्राह्मं वेदं ब्रह्मप्रतिपादकम् उपनिषद्भागं ब्राह्मणयोग्यं वा । पितामहं व्यासम् ॥५॥

verses.sanskrit:
व्यास उवाच।
              मयेदं व्यसनं पूर्वं विदितं भरतर्षभाः। यथा तु तैरधर्मेण धार्तराष्ट्रैर्विवासिताः॥७॥
verses.english: Vyasa said : O best of the Bharata race, I knew beforehand of your this affection, your this unjust banishment by the sons of Dhritarashtra. Knowing this I have come to do you some great good. You ought not to grieve. Know all this is for your (future) happiness.

verses.sanskrit: तद्विदित्वाऽस्मि संप्राप्तश्चिकीर्षुः परमं हितम्। न विषादोऽत्र कर्तव्यः सर्वमेतत्सुखाय वः॥८॥
समास्ते चैव मे सर्वे यूयं चैव न संशयः। दीनतो बालतश्चैव स्नेहं कुर्वन्ति मानवाः। तस्मादभ्यधिकः स्नेहो युष्मासु मम सांप्रतम्॥९॥
verses.english: There is no doubt that you and they all are equal in my eyes; but men love more those that are in misfortune or in tender years. Therefore my love for you is now greater (then before) and in consequence of the love, I wish to do you some good. Listen to me. Not far from this place there is a beautiful town which is a safe place for you. There live you all in disguise, waiting for my return.

verses.sanskrit: स्नेहपूर्वं चिकीर्षामि हितं वस्तन्निबोधत। इदं नगरमभ्याशे रमणीयं निरामयम्। वसतेह प्रतिच्छन्ना ममागमनकाङ्क्षिणः॥१०॥

वैशंपायन उवाच।
              एवं स तान्समाश्वास्य व्यासः सत्यवतीसुतः। एकचक्रामभिगतः कुन्तीमाश्वासयत्प्रभुः॥११॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said : Having thus comforted them, the son of a Satyavati, Vyasa, led them to (the town of) Ekachakra. The lord (Vyasa) comforted Kunti also.

verses.sanskrit:
व्यास उवाच।
              जीवत्पुत्रि सुतस्तेऽयं धर्मनित्यो युधिष्ठिरः। धर्मेण पृथिवीं जित्वा महात्मा पुरुषर्षभः। पृथिव्यां पार्थिवान्सर्वान्प्रशासिष्यति धर्मराट्॥१२॥
verses.english: Vyasa said: O daughter, live your this son, the illustrious and the best of men, Yudhisthira, ever devoted to virtue, conquering the word by his virtue will virtuously rule over all the kings of the world.

verses.sanskrit: पृथिवीमखिलां जित्वा सर्वां सागरमेखलाम्। भीमसेनार्जुनबलाद्भोक्ष्यते नात्र संशयः॥१३॥
verses.english: Conquering the whole earth bounded by the belt of the sea by the prowess of Bhima and Arjuna, there is no doubt (he will rule the world).

verses.sanskrit: पुत्रास्तव च माद्र्याश्च सर्व एव महारथाः। स्वराष्ट्रे विहरिष्यन्ति सुखं सुमनसः सदा॥१४॥
verses.english: Your sons and those of Madri, all great car warriors, will sport in their own kingdom at pleasure.

verses.sanskrit: यक्ष्यन्ति च नरव्याघ्रा निर्जित्य पृथिवीमिमाम्। राजसूयाश्वमेधाद्यैः क्रतुभिर्भूरिदक्षिणैः॥१५॥
verses.english: Conquering the whole world, these best of men will perform Rajasuya and Ashvamedha and other sacrifices in which Dakshina (presents to the Brahmanas) will be very large.

verses.sanskrit: अनुग्रृह्य सुह्रद्वर्गं भोगैश्वर्यसुखेन च। पितृपैतामहं राज्यमिमे भोक्ष्यन्ति ते सुताः॥१६॥
verses.english: Maintaining their friends and relatives in luxury and affluence, these your so will rule over the kingdom of their forefathers.
Vaishampayana said : Having said this, he took them to the house of a Brahmana and then Rishi Dvaipayana spoke thus to the eldest Pandava-

verses.sanskrit: इह मासं प्रतीक्षध्वमागमिष्याम्यहं पुनः। देशकालौ विदित्वैव लप्स्यध्वं परमां मुदम्॥१८॥
verses.english: “Wait here for me. I shall come back to you. You will be able to obtain great happiness by adopting yourself to the place and time (in which you are now).”

verses.sanskrit: स तैः प्राञ्जलिभिः सर्वैस्तथेत्युक्तो नराधिप। जगाम भगवान्व्यासो यथागतमृषिः प्रभुः॥१९॥
verses.english: O king, they all said with joined hands, "Be it so." (Thereupon) the illustrious lord, the Rishi Vyasa, went away from whence he came.
